0022600192.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, 8th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 4th in the West), who have won three straight and are 4-0 at home, while Washington has lost its last two games and is 2-3 on the road. Missing for Washington are Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and missing for Oklahoma City are Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 0-2 to the Thunder, including a 132-111 loss in Washington on March 21, 2026.
